Is there a subscription or refill option?
We do not offer an automatic recurring subscription for refills, but we sell individual replacement nesting refills—such as natural lakebed reeds, cardboard BeeTubes, and reusable wood trays—as one-time purchases.
Because nesting materials should be replaced or cleaned annually to prevent pests and diseases from building up, you can easily reorder refills each season whenever you are ready.
